en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large brick fire station with a tall, ornate hose‑drying/watch tower rising above the main building. The architecture is 19th‑century historicist with arched windows and decorative brickwork. The foreground shows a cobblestone street, fence, and hedges; there are telegraph poles and a streetlamp. Printed captions in red read "Helsingfors" on the lower left and "Brandstation" on the lower right. The lower part of the card contains handwritten cursive text.
